bicepsEase.name: Biceps ease (%)
bicepsEase.help: The amount of ease at your upper arm. Note that while we try to respect this, fitting the sleeve to the armhole takes precedence over respecting the exact amount of ease.

chestEase.name: Chest ease (%)
chestEase.help: The amount of ease at your chest.

collarEase.name: Collar ease (%)
collarEase.help: The amount of ease around your neck

cuffEase.name: Cuff ease (%)
cuffEase.help: The amount of ease at your wrist.

shoulderEase.name: Shoulder ease (%)
shoulderEase.help: The amount of ease at your shoulder. This increases the shoulder to shoulder distance to accommodate additional layers or thickness.

lengthBonus.name: Length bonus (%)
lengthBonus.help: The amount to lengthen the garment. A negative value will shorten it.

centerBackDart.name: Center back dart (%)
centerBackDart.help: Dart at the center back of your neck to accommodate a rounded back

hipsEase.name: Hips ease (%)
hipsEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at your hips

waistEase.name: Waist ease (%)
waistEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at your waist

sleeveLengthBonus.name: Sleeve length bonus (%)
sleeveLengthBonus.help: The amount to lengthen the sleeve. A negative value will shorten it.

sleeveBend.name: Sleeve bend (°)
sleeveBend.help: Controls the bend of the sleeve at the elbow.

centerFrontHemDrop.name: Center front hem drop (%)
centerFrontHemDrop.help: The amount by which the hem is lowered towards the center front

frontCutawayAngle.name: Front cutaway angle (°)
frontCutawayAngle.help: The angle under which the front is cut away towards the hem

frontCutawayStart.name: Front cutaway start (%)
frontCutawayStart.help: The location at which the front starts opening up towards the hem

frontCutawayEnd.name: Front cutaway end (%)
frontCutawayEnd.help: Increasing this will make the front cutaway stay closer to the center front

hemRadius.name: Hem radius (%)
hemRadius.help: The amount by which the hem is rounded

lapelStart.name: Lapel start (%)
lapelStart.help: Location where the center front goes over into the lapels

buttonLength.name: Button length (%)
buttonLength.help: The distance over which buttons are spread

lapelReduction.name: Lapel reduction (%)
lapelReduction.help: How much the tip of the lapels turns inwards

backVentLength.name: Back vent length (%)
backVentLength.help: The length of the back vent(s)

draftForHighBust.name: Draft for high bust
draftForHighBust.help: Draft the pattern using the high bust measurement if it is available, instead of using the chest measurement. This can result in a more fitted garment for people with breasts. (Please note that no additional adjustments or shaping is performed. Further manual adjustments may be needed for those with a larger difference between high bust and chest measurements.)

acrossBackFactor.name: Across back factor (%)
acrossBackFactor.help: Controls your across back width as a factor of your shoulder to shoulder measurement.

armholeDepth.name: Armhole depth (%)
armholeDepth.help: Controls the depth of the armhole. Higher values make a deeper armhole.

armholeDepthFactor.name: Armhole depth factor (legacy) (%)
armholeDepthFactor.help: Controls the depth of the armhole. Higher values make a deeper armhole. This option only applies to the legacy (v2) way of calculating the armhole depth.

backNeckCutout.name: Back neck cutout (%)
backNeckCutout.help: How deep the neck is cut out at the back

frontArmholeDeeper.name: Front armhole extra cutout (%)
frontArmholeDeeper.help: How much do you want the front armhole to be cut out deeper than the back.

shoulderSlopeReduction.name: Shoulder slope reduction (%)
shoulderSlopeReduction.help: The amount by which the shoulder slope is reduced to allow for shoulder padding.

legacyArmholeDepth.name: Legacy armhole depth
legacyArmholeDepth.help: Enable this option to use the legacy way to calculate the armhole depth (using biceps circumference) rather than the v3 way (using the waist to armpit measurement)

sideFrontPlacement.name: Side/Front placement (%)
sideFrontPlacement.help: The location of the side/front boundary

frontOverlap.name: Front overlap (%)
frontOverlap.help: How far the fabric extends beyond the closing buttons

chestShaping.name: Chest shaping (%)
chestShaping.help: Amount of shaping to accommodate for the chest curve

sleevecapHeight.name: Sleevecap height (%)
sleevecapHeight.help: Controls the height of the sleevecap.

sleevecapEase.name: Sleevecap ease (%)
sleevecapEase.help: The amount by which the sleevecap seam is longer than the armhole seam.

rollLineCollarHeight.name: Roll-line collar height (%)
rollLineCollarHeight.help: How much the roll-line hugs the neck

collarNotchReturn.name: Collar notch return (%)
collarNotchReturn.help: How much the collar returns from the notch, in comparison to the lapel

collarSpread.name: Collar spread (°)
collarSpread.help: The collar spread controls how the collar drapes over the shoulders

collarRoll.name: Collar roll (%)
collarRoll.help: Controls the amount of roll in the collar; how much the topcollar is higher than the undercollar.

frontPocketWidth.name: Front pocket width (%)
frontPocketWidth.help: The width of the front pocket

frontPocketDepth.name: Front pocket depth (%)
frontPocketDepth.help: The depth of the front pocket

frontPocketRadius.name: Front pocket radius (%)
frontPocketRadius.help: The radius by which the front pocket is rounded

innerPocketPlacement.name: Inner pocket placement (%)
innerPocketPlacement.help: The location of the inner pocket

innerPocketWidth.name: Inner pocket width (%)
innerPocketWidth.help: The width of the inner pocket

innerPocketDepth.name: Inner pocket depth (%)
innerPocketDepth.help: The depth of the inner pocket

innerPocketWeltHeight.name: Inner pocket welt height (%)
innerPocketWeltHeight.help: The height of the inner pocket welt

chestPocketDepth.name: Chest pocket depth (%)
chestPocketDepth.help: The depth of the chest pocket

chestPocketWidth.name: Chest pocket width (%)
chestPocketWidth.help: The width of the chest pocket

chestPocketPlacement.name: Chest pocket placement (%)
chestPocketPlacement.help: The location of the chest pocket

chestPocketAngle.name: Chest pocket angle (°)
chestPocketAngle.help: The angle under which the chest pocket is placed

chestPocketWeltSize.name: Chest pocket welt size (%)
chestPocketWeltSize.help: The size of the chest pocket welt

pocketFoldover.name: Pocket fold-over (%)
pocketFoldover.help: The amount by which the main fabric is folder over into the pocket
